summary: Kimi Antonelli's maiden Ferrari campaign collides with a nation torn between backing their homegrown driver and demanding Scuderia redemption at Monza. Pierre Gasly's stunning Alpine pole position upends the Mercedes-Ferrari power struggle, forcing both giants to chase an outsider's pace on Monza's high-speed straits where Hamilton admits Ferrari still trails Mercedes in raw engine power. A victory here could catalyze Antonelli's title credentials while simultaneously revitalizing Ferrari's championship momentum—or expose the Prancing Horse as merely a threat rather than a contender.
